meaning: Detergent cup blocked: something is stopping the detergent cup from opening fully.
causes: Silverware, a pan, pot handles or other tall items touching the detergent cup
A detergent pod or tablet not lined up in the cup, binding the cover
Old detergent residue left in the cup from a previous wash
diySteps: Remove the obstruction (for example silverware or a pan), close and latch the door, and wait 30 seconds for the cup to open
Reload so nothing touches the detergent cup. On flip-open cups it is normal for the cover to open about 45 degrees and rest against the upper rack
Wipe out any old detergent left in the cup
If you use pods or tablets, line them up in the opening so they cannot bind the cover; if you use powder, it should be fresh and loose, not lumpy
safetyNote: Switch the dishwasher off at its breaker before you reach into the base or remove a filter or cover, and let the tub and water cool after a cycle. Watch for sharp debris. Pump, heater, valve and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: If the cup still does not open after these checks, GE says service may be needed.
